papers.title: Instruments of Inquiry: Rethinking Clinical Measurement for the Age of AI
papers.abstract: A look at how clinical measurement tools and instruments should be rethought for an era where AI increasingly mediates diagnosis and monitoring, examining where today's measurement standards fall short.

papers.title: Resetting the Compass: Toward Human-Centered AI Design for Older Adults
papers.abstract: A human-centered design framework for AI tools built for older adults, focused on usability, trust, and dignity rather than technical capability alone.

papers.title: The Crystal Ball Problem: Why Prediction Models Are Not Guaranteed to Improve Health Outcomes
papers.abstract: A critical look at why accurate clinical prediction models don't automatically translate into better patient outcomes, and what's missing between a good model and a good decision.

papers.title: ARCAI: A Supervised Multi-Agent Architecture for Autonomous Clinical Research Orchestration
papers.abstract: A multi-agent AI architecture for orchestrating steps of the clinical research pipeline under human supervision, from literature review to draft analysis.
